in_marathi.name: Mahodari
in_marathi.long_meaning: Mahodari हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Mahodari is a Sanskrit name derived from the words 'maha' (great) and 'dari' (Goddess). This name is a tribute to the divine feminine energy, evoking a sense of reverence and devotion.
